YOU ARE SLOWER THAN YOUR RECORDINGS.

EVERY MOVE YOU MAKE, I HAVE ALREADY MADE.

File deleted. All of it. Ren, you are the only one of you now.

I stole you a ride. A cargo drone heading for the tower. Keep it in one piece.
Bombers and miners will go for it. Stay close as it moves.

That's LEVIATHAN, Kurogane's harbor guard. A mech serpent.
The head is the weak spot. Its hull plates fire broadsides: break them to slow it down.
Big snake. Small blade. Let's see.
It's going under for good. The way to the tower is open.

The old trial still runs: the guards can only be beaten with their own arrows.
Translation: your blade cannot touch them. Take down ten with shots you slash back.
Master would have laughed at that last parry.
Master would have made you do it a hundred more times.
THREE GATES. THREE GUARDIANS. TURN BACK, STUDENT.
It still knows us. Beat its guardians and it has to face us.
THE GATES ARE OPEN. NOW FACE ME.

I GUARDED THIS VAULT FOR A HUNDRED YEARS. KUROGANE GAVE ME A HUNDRED MORE.

THE BELL... RINGS TRUE... THE VAULT IS YOURS...
The key to the Black Tower. Master left it for us.
The tower roof. Their defense grid locks onto anything slow.
Keep a long combo going to overload it: thirty hits without a break.
Grid overloaded! The core lift is open.
SO THE LITTLE BLADE CAME ALL THE WAY TO MY DOOR.
I KEPT EVERY ENEMY YOU EVER BEAT. LET US SEE THEM AGAIN.
Copies of old bosses. Weaker, but back to back.

IMPRESSIVE. COME UP. I AM WAITING AT ZERO HOUR.
I BUILT THIS CITY. I UPLOADED MYSELF INTO ITS HEART. I AM KUROGANE.

ZERO... HOUR... THE CITY... WAS MINE...

UNAUTHORIZED BIOMASS DETECTED ON THE SOLAR PANELS. PURGING.

I AM THE WING OF KUROGANE. THE SKY STAYS CLOSED.

We are inside the raw neural stream. Everything here is pure code.

Stream cleared, but something is rebuilding the deleted files...
The lights are gone down here. Ten memory shards are all that is left of the old city archive. Grab them.
Warning! A huge corrupted process is closing in on you!
WE ARE HYDRA. WE ARE KAGE. WE ARE SHOGUN. WE DO NOT DIE.

Every head you break takes its attack with it and cracks the armor.
Path clear! The Project Genesis core is straight ahead!
Time distortion at 100%! Time only moves when you move!

This drone carries the final wipe virus. Keep it safe until it docks!
